changes: Added experiments/recovery-runner/checks.mjs: the deterministic scoring-checks layer per pre-reg section 4.1/2/7 — harnessAcceptance (SHA-256 hash-check the harness-owned acceptance script BEFORE running it; runner not invoked on mismatch), hiddenRegression (no NEW failing tests vs baseline by id; fail-closed on corrupt/null/id-less entries), diffHygiene (path confined + junk flagged; path-traversal rejected; DEFAULT_JUNK_PATTERNS frozen + private snapshot so external mutation cannot change scoring) — exact section-7 field names acceptancePass/hiddenRegressionPass/diffHygienePass; plus checks-selfcheck.mjs (112 offline assertions).
usage: import { harnessAcceptance, hiddenRegression, diffHygiene } from checks.mjs to score section-5 completion deterministically; verify offline via node experiments/recovery-runner/checks-selfcheck.mjs (no live LLM).
expectedOutcome: A spec-faithful, anti-gaming, tamper-proof completion-scoring layer for the powered ablation; hash-before-execute; fail-closed on corrupt inputs; frozen junk patterns.
actualTranscript: selfcheck 112/112 pass (no LLM, negative control 12/99 forced-fail confirms non-vacuous); genuine 2-host: round-1 3 claude lanes PASS + codex host-2 BLOCK on 2 HIGH (corrupt-baseline fail-open; mutable junk-pattern global) → fixed (a9881124c) → round-2 all 3 claude lanes PASS + codex host-2 SHIP; full npm test green.
outcomeDiff: expected == actual: hash-before-execute, fail-closed regression, frozen+private junk patterns, section-7 names.
limitations: Pure module; wiring into the live run driver (clean-checkout + baseline-snapshot capture) is the next infra piece. The actual GLMM/run still pending.
pitfalls: A pure scorer can be silently gameable via (a) fail-OPEN on corrupt baseline entries and (b) a mutable exported pattern global — both caught by codex host-2, missed by all 3 claude lanes (3rd consecutive cross-vendor catch). Always fail-closed + freeze shared defaults.
